name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v1892: Not a defect in his code but in mine, four times in one night and all the same family: a source guard that fails on its own reach rather than on the thing it checks - a byte window a comment pushed past, my own placeholder inside a comment, an unbounded comment stripper that ate a sixth of the file, and an anchor that matched a new call site instead of a definition. Every one produced an empty or truncated slice, and an empty slice does not announce itself because assertNotIn passes on one. There is a safe helper now that refuses all three failure directions, and a ratchet pinning the twenty-six byte-counted slices so the class cannot grow.
